launch_only_after: Batch 003 user reviewed, saved and its provisional not-useful exclusions archived
launch_mechanism: Revalidate current canonical manifest, taxonomic HOLDs, active worker claims and permanent library scan history, then copy approved IDs to workflow/photo-library/requests/diagnostic-batch-004.json (GitHub workflow triggers on request path).
source: Public licensed GBIF and Pl@ntNet via GBIF
must_not_run_while: Photo Lab 003 contains unsaved user-visible labels in browser localStorage

image_review_focus.Apocynaceae: corona and flower structures, foliage, fruit follicles
image_review_focus.Asteraceae: phyllaries, heads, leaves and achene stage
image_review_focus.Quercus: buds, acorn cup and leaf undersides

protections: No edits to completed 001 and 002 GitHub review files.
No removal or replacement of Batch 003 live review until its labels are preserved.
Do not install candidate photos into species cards until image-level validation.
Do not alter five scheduled automations.
Skip any species gaining a claim, taxonomic HOLD or prior harvest before launch.
